description:
On the week marking 110 years since the birth of Sun Ra, NTS dedicates a full day to broadcasting from his expansive musical universe.
Featuring rare insights into his early life, interviews with friends and admirers, and several lovingly selected hours of his galaxy-exploring jazz sound.
title: 110 Years of Sun Ra
